How fast can you outrun true love? Faster than your friends?  Find out with our newly added Leaderboards.

-Leaderboard added to all levels except the Bedroom and bonus levels.
-Diffuculty reduced on some garage levels.
-Leaderboard screens available on the title screen, pause menu, and end of level summary.

notes.title: Now Available on Steam - Mushroom Men: Truffle Trouble
notes.notes:
Mushroom Men: Truffle Trouble is Now Available on Steam!

Truffle Trouble is a unique game featuring Pax, the hero of Mushroom Men, that combines classic platforming action with imaginative puzzle-solving as you must move, stack, and use objects to create new paths to jump and clamber on, all while the besotted Truffle Princess draws ever closer.
